plugins.name: story
plugins.description: AI-native project management for coding agents. A full story lifecycle: bare `/story` lists ready stories to pick from, `/story new` files one, `/story do <id>` dispatches a ready story to a fresh plan-mode Claude session in a new tmux window + per-story git worktree, and `/story complete <id>` closes it and safely reclaims the worktree and merged branch. `/story work`, `/story context`, and friends cover the rest of the session lifecycle. Proactive story tracking, session handoffs, and dependency-aware task selection via the storyhook CLI.
